lines.text:
BROCK: ...You sure look different from when
we first met!\c
I have a request for you, since you’re now
the Pokémon League Champion.\c
The truth is, Gym Leaders have the right to
challenge the Champion!\c
...Please allow me the privilege of facing you
in battle once again!\c
Allow me to show you the true rock-hard
strength of my Pokémon!
BROCK: No matter what kind of opponent you\nmay be, my Rock-type Pokémon will take you on!\c\nThat’s the promise of my rock-hard will!

BROCK: I’ve chosen to postpone my dream of
becoming a Pokémon Breeder just for a little
bit longer.\c
Right now I’m more interested in training to
grow strong enough to one day face and
defeat you!\c
Please, battle me every day so I can grow
even stronger!
